categories.title: Checkweighers
categories.description: High-performance checkweighers for inline weight verification and quality control. Reliable detection of underweight and overweight products in food, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, and industrial production lines at speeds up to 600 products per minute.

categories.title: Catchweighers & DWS
categories.description: Industrial scales and DWS systems for logistics and e-commerce applications. High-speed solutions for parcel weighing up to 60 kg at 3.4 m/s with exceptional accuracy. Optimized for CEP organizations, warehouses, and distribution centers with throughput up to 11,000 parcels per hour.
